definitions.explanation: A smooth, reflective shine on a surface. Used for materials like fabric, hair, metal, paper, and finished products.

examples.japanese: {光沢|こうたく}のある{布|ぬの}。
この{革|かわ}は{磨|みが}くと{美|うつく}しい{光沢|こうたく}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: This leather develops a beautiful luster when polished.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{使|つか}い{込|こ}まれた{木|き}のテーブルは、{深|ふか}い{光沢|こうたく}を{帯|お}びていた。
examples.english: The wooden table, used for many years, had taken on a deep sheen.

notes:
USAGE:
{光沢|こうたく} refers to a reflective quality on surfaces and is commonly used in product descriptions, material science, and everyday descriptions of polished or glossy items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {光沢|こうたく}がある (have a sheen)
- {光沢|こうたく}を{出|だ}す (bring out a sheen)
- {光沢|こうたく}を{帯|お}びる (take on a luster)
- {光沢|こうたく}{仕上|しあ}げ (glossy finish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {艶|つや} is a more everyday word for gloss or sheen, often used for hair and skin
- {光沢|こうたく} is more technical and formal, common in product descriptions and material contexts
